title: Replay, don't trust: verifiers re-run handoff commands themselves
subject: replay-dont-trust
ratio: Verifiers re-run handoff commands themselves. Producer logs, notes and claims of green runs are inputs to replay, never substitutes for it: a verdict rests on commands the verifier executed and output the verifier saw. Accepting unreplayed producer evidence at a verdict is a protocol violation.
dicta: Bootstrap-seeded at generation 0; no P-number, so tier 2 is not honestly available (CD6); tier 3 rests on T-052 (cronsplain epic final join: full-suite replay before verdict, done by harness-verifier, distinct from the epic producers) and T-054 (swarm replay verdicted by verifier-d). The PRECEDENT.md section 3 preamble names replay-dont-trust as the tier system basis. Frozen by the codification ledger row decision:T-377#cd-05.
scope_conditions: role:verifier evaluating any handoff evidence before a verdict
revisit_trigger: Revisit if a verdict based on unreplayed producer logs is accepted at an epic join.
validity_conditions: verifier verdicts require replayed commands with executed-output evidence
